$comment: Nissan RB25DET NEO (NEO Straight 6), launch swap. Researched 2026-09-29. Top-level hardware is the ER34 Skyline 25GT Turbo engine; variants split by rated output: ER34 5MT 1998-05 to 2000-07 (35.0 kgf·m), ER34 5MT from 2000-08 (37.0 kgf·m, own turbo, camshaft and ECU per the parts catalogue), ER34 4AT (34.0), WC34 Stagea (from 1998-08: 34.0 on the automatics, 35.0 on the 5MT 25t RS FOUR S, a separate variant), C35 Laurel (from 1998-09, 4AT, 34.0) and Y34 Cedric/Gloria 4WD (260 PS, later 250 PS). The ER34 25GT FOUR (ENR34) is not a NEO turbo: every 4WD Skyline R34 used the NA RB25DE. Primary sources: Nissan releases of 1998-05-25, 1998-08-31 (page images) and 2000-08-28, the English R34 Series service manual on archive.org (service data only), and the Nissan parts catalogue (EPC) read at megazip.net. JDM ratings are cross-checked on goo-net and Car Sensor. Weak points: dry weight (disputed, 180-260 kg) and outline dimensions come only from spec aggregators; crank and rod material only from an aggregator; the stock-internals limits are rules of thumb (Tomei, TorqueCars) and one owner dyno; the intercooler position is sourced for the ER34 only, and the 4WD sump position is inferred.

Factory gearboxes behind the NEO: FS5R30A 5-speed manual and RE4R01B 4-speed automatic (M-ATx) in the ER34 (R34 service manual GI-3); the WC34 Stagea and C35 Laurel automatics and the Stagea 25t RS FOUR S 5MT share their catalogue gear ratios (2.785 first, 4.083 final on the automatics; 3.214 first on the manuals). The FS5R30A for the RB is shared in family with the VG30 300ZX box (Eat Sleep Boost). Clutch: the R34 turbo manual is pull type (Nissan 1998 release: adopted for easier operation), while R33 RB25DET boxes are push type (Eat Sleep Boost), so an R33 box behind a NEO needs the matching cover, release bearing and fork; disc and cover are 250 mm (service manual SD-8). The NA ER34 grades (RB25DE, RB20DE) use the lighter FS5W71C 5-speed (service manual GI-3). S-chassis swaps: the RB25 box shifter sits too far back and the tunnel needs work (Eat Sleep Boost).
